assumption: Nominal release BST calendar days compared with published EPA date labels; station-day averaging timezone and original QA remain unresolved. UTC and ±1day sensitivity retained without choosing the best after seeing scores.
comparison_type: Conditional paired independent-point-reference comparison; regional spatial support differs, not causal or operational validation.
bootstrap: Moving calendar blocks of7/30days; conditional sampling intervals, not measurement/model-structural uncertainty.

mirror.point: All four conventions are sensitivity checks, not four independent stations; exact averaging convention remains a source question.
